channel.title: Think Mybiz Insights
channel.description: Tax and compliance insights from Think Mybiz Accountants & Tax Practitioners

item.title: CSD registration step by step for small businesses
item.description: How to register on the government Central Supplier Database, the information you need, how tax details are checked, and how to stay active.

item.title: EMP501 reconciliation: fixing mismatches before SARS does
item.description: What the EMP501 must balance, why payroll, EMP201s, payments and IRP5s drift apart, how to correct them, and the penalties and ETI refunds at stake.

item.title: How to object to a SARS assessment (and why vague objections fail)
item.description: Disagree with a SARS assessment? The 80-business-day deadline, when to request reasons first, what a valid objection must contain and what happens next.

item.title: Missed the deadline to object? How late objections and condonation work
item.description: Missed the 80-business-day objection deadline? How SARS treats late objections, reasonable grounds vs exceptional circumstances, and the 3-year limit.

item.title: Received a SARS letter of demand? Your options explained
item.description: Owe SARS and received a letter of demand? The four options SARS allows, what a payment arrangement needs, and what happens if you do nothing.

item.title: SARS penalty remission: when a request (RFR) can work
item.description: Charged a SARS penalty? What a request for remission must contain, the circumstances SARS accepts, why you must file first, and what to do if refused.

item.title: SARS tax debt compromise: who qualifies and what SARS asks for
item.description: When SARS may accept less than the full tax debt, the documents a compromise application needs, and SARS's expedited compromise process through RCBs.

item.title: SARS verification letter: what to send, how and by when
item.description: Selected for SARS verification? What verification is, how to submit documents, what happens to your refund, and what to do if you disagree with the result.

item.title: Tax compliance status (TCS) PIN for tenders: why it shows non-compliant
item.description: How the SARS tax compliance status PIN works for tenders, why your status shows red, how to fix it before a tender deadline, and how to challenge it.
